summary: chore(shared): move Glean YAML and generated web code out of fxa-shared
description:
Because:

* The FxA Glean YAML now lives in libs/shared/metrics/glean/src/registry
* fxa-settings is the only consumer of the generated glean/web code

This commit:

* Removes the FxA Glean YAML and unused pair-reasons.ts from fxa-shared
* Moves the generated glean/web code into fxa-settings src/lib/glean/web
* Points the glean-generate and glean-lint scripts at the registry

Closes FXA-14711
